Overview

Daily sunscreen is the single most useful step for protecting skin long term. A comfortable texture is what makes people actually use it every day.

Check that the product is labelled broad-spectrum so it covers both UVA and UVB, and apply generously.

Who it is for

Everyone, every morning, including cloudy days.

How to use

  1. Apply as the last morning skincare step.
  2. Use roughly a quarter teaspoon for the face and neck.
  3. Reapply about every two hours outdoors.

What to look for

Broad-spectrum label
Covers UVA and UVB.
SPF 30 or higher
Commonly recommended minimum.
Water resistance
Helpful for sport and holidays.

Good to know

  • Elegant, wearable finish
  • Works under makeup
  • Daily-use friendly

Things to consider

  • Chemical filters can sting eyes for some people
  • Rules and filter lists differ between regions

General information only, not medical advice. Patch test new products and speak with a doctor or dermatologist about skin concerns.
